dhp259:6:
nappamajjati → na tāvatā dharmadharo yāvatā bahu bhāṣate 
yastavīhālapampi śrætvā dharmakāyena vai yathāśen 
sa vai dharmadharo bhavatī yo dharme na pramadyāte. (udānavarga 4. 5. 21) 
na tavata dhamadharo yavata baho bhaṣati 
yo tu apa bi śutvāna dhamu kaphala phasati 
sa ho dhamadharo bhoti yo dhamu na pramajati (pra. dha. A 3 10)
dhp260:4:
vuccati → na tena vṛḍo bhavatī yekāsya palitaṃ śiraඃ 
yo vai yuvā’pyadhīyānasataṃdevāඃ sthaviraṃ viduඃ (manusmṛti. 2. 153)
dhp266:4:
tāvatā → bhikṣurna tāvatā bhavati yācatā bhikṣate parān 
viṣamān dharmān samādāya bhikṣurbhoti na tāvatā. (mahāvastu. 3 piṭa 423) 
na bhikhu tavata hoti yavata bhijati para 
viśapadharma samadai hikhu hoti na tavata. (prā. dha. B. 26)
dhp267:4:
vuccati → yastukāmāṃśva pāpaṃ ca dhikkṛtvā brahmacaryavān 
niඃśreṇibhūto saprajño savai bhikṣurti ucyate (mahāvastu 3. piṭa 423) 
yā tu baheti pavana vata va bramacayiyaca. 
saghai carati loku so tu hikhu tu vucati. (prā. dha. B. 27)
dhp271:4:
vā → na śīlavratamātreṇa bāhuśrætyena vā punaඃ 
atha vā samādhilābhena prāntaśayyāsanena ca 
na śīlavatamatrena bahosutena va pano 
adha samadhilabhena vivitaśayanena va (prā, dha. B 22)
dhp272:4:
āsavakkhayaṃ → sapṛhayaṃ naiṣakāmyasukhaṃ apṛthagjanasevitam 
bhikṣu viśvāsammāpado aprāpeta āśravakṣaye. (udānavarga) 
phuṣamu nekhamasukhu aprædhajanasevi 
hikhu viśpaśama ........... apate aśava chaye (prā. dha. B. 25)
